title: Copy complete ordinary CSV fields directly into admitted destinations
question: Can the strict serial parser remove an intermediate scratch copy?
summary: Deliver the ordinary-field copy optimization as the stronger serial baseline, with modest scoped timing evidence.

workloads: One million unquoted ASCII ordered-export rows, one worker and 32-MiB job memory.

validation.summary: The recorded native comparison and parser semantic/ownership controls preserve strict validation, error placement and special-field handling.

limitations: Small development cells and uncontrolled cache/background state do not establish general device, shape or tail performance.
Historical percentage gains are not additive; every comparison uses its own pinned baseline.
Fast path requires a complete nonempty unquoted field ending at delimiter/LF in the current input buffer.
exclusions: Component-probe throughput is not a whole-job gain; quoted, split, CRLF and final-field paths keep prior handling.
